item.title: AI Went Bad (And Anthropic Caught Them)
item.description:
Anthropic's Threat Intelligence team disrupted operations where hackers, spies, and propagandists used Claude to conduct cyber attacks, run influence campaigns, and commit fraud—often in ways that made individual operators as dangerous as nation-states. We break down the real cases from Russian espionage to election manipulation to "AI-powered fake news factories."
Source: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/e50be2e51e7695dc4b1366a37a245a597377d3b5/Anthropic-Detecting-and-countering-091026.pdf

item.title: Stanford: how AI is reshaping the future of work
Pressure Washing: Finding Vulnerabilities with LLMs
item.description:
Scoop Sterling and Professor Nutshell break down Teleport's pressure washing experiment: 13 engineers, 3 months, and nearly double the high-severity vulnerabilities found versus the prior two years combined. Why their complex multi-agent harness underperformed simple prompts, the two techniques that actually worked, and why expert-guided AI beat full automation.
Source: https://goteleport.com/blog/finding-vulnerabilities-with-llms/
